newsitem.title: UK: Rotterdam bunkers flat in average demand.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers flat in average demand.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices were little changed on Tuesday amid average demand totalling 10,000 to 15,000 tonnes, brokers said.
They said 380 cSt fuel was priced at $84/85 a tonne, with 180 cSt at $90/91. Antwerp prices were about $1 higher.
Mediterranean prices were also flat, with Piraeus 380 cSt at $90/92 and 180 cSt at $96/98 after firming on Monday.
In the Gulf, Fujairah prices were stable at $97 and $103 respectively.
